name: National Mental Health Helpline
description: A national helpline for mental health support. Call to ask about available help and referral options for qualified mental health professionals. Individual counselor profiles are not listed here.
hours: Contact the service to confirm current availability.

name: National Institute of Mental Health
description: Government mental health institute in Mulleriyawa New Town. Contact the institute for information about services, referrals, and visiting arrangements.
hours: Contact the institute to confirm current hours and services.

name: Dementia Hotline
description: A dedicated hotline listed by NIMH. Call for information and support related to dementia.
hours: Contact the service to confirm current availability.

name: Sri Lanka Sumithrayo — Founding Branch
description: Free emotional support and befriending. The organization says callers may remain anonymous and information shared is confidential. This is a support service, not a substitute for emergency care.
hours: Daily, 9:00 AM–8:00 PM (as listed by the organization).
